newsitem.title: POLAND: Pope arrives for seventh visit to Poland.
newsitem.headline: Pope arrives for seventh visit to Poland.

text.p: Pope John Paul arrived in Poland on Saturday to start an 11-day visit of 12 cities during the seventh visit of his pontificate to his homeland.
The 77-year-old Pope was met at Wroclaw airport by leaders of the Polish Church and President Alexander Kwasniewski, a former communist.
The 77-year-old Pontiff looked frail but relaxed as he emerged from his aircraft to an official welcome at the rainswept airport.

He was due to confer later in the day with Kwasniewski who says he is anxious to end enmities with the Church that have been fanned by liberal abortion laws and the government's insistence on a mainly-secular new constitution.

Although the Church said John Paul would not enter the political debate in Poland, his visit is taking place at the outset of a parliamentary election campaign in which a coalition of pro-church parties and the ruling ex-communist alliance are running level.
Around four million pilgrims were expected to see the Pope during his appearances in cities across a swathe of western and southern Poland in his first trip to the country since 1995.
